 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1 .  Md. Arbaz, son of Md. Abbas, aged about 24 years, resident of  Village Pagar, P.O. & P.S,. Keredari, District Hazaribagh, State  Jharkhand  2.

Md. Faiz Akhtar @ Raju, son of Md. Salim Akhtar, aged about 38  years, resident of village Dari, P.O. & P.S. Simariya, District Chatra,
 State Jharkhand ...... Petitioners
Versus  The State of Jharkhand ......Opposite party

CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA -----
For the Petitioners : Mr. Naveen Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shailesh Kr. Sinha, A.P.P. .....
Order No.06/ Dated:13.09.2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending their arrest in connection Tandwa P.S. Case No.195 of 2018, registered for the offence under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 120(B) & 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 21 of the MMDR Act, the petitioners have moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. As per FIR, allegation is that irregularities were found in view of department letter in compliance of JIMMS System.

As per list since April 2018 to August 2018 it has been informed by M/s Lalitpur Power Generation Ltd. and M/s Lalitpur Power Generation Ltd, M/s J.V.K. Power Govindbal Sahib Ltd. Company, that the coal were being transported from Amrapali project through non-commercial vehicles, motorcycles and motorcars etc.

entities.text: J.V.K. Power Govindbal Sahib Ltd. Company
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
It is further mentioned that dispatch orders are issued in favour of the Delivery Order Holders by M/s. CCL Amrapali Project and Magadh Project and it has been informed that Delivery order holders, Transporters, Lifters Truck Owners and truck drivers were using the vehicles i.e. motorcycles, motorcars and three wheelers in illegal transportation.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that petitioners are innocent and have committed no offence at all rather they have been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that other Co-accused, namely, Dinesh Ganjhu has been granted anticipatory bail in A.B.A. No.9942 of 2023 vide order dated 11th January, 2024.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioners undertake to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
Hence, the petitioners may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Md. Arbaz vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, the petitioners are directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of their arrest or surrendering, they will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Chatra in connection with Tandwa P.S. Case No.195 of 2018 with the condition that they will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish their mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that they will not change their mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
